tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: ye shes rab 'bar las: grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad sel ba'i thabs bzhugs so:

ye shes rab 'bar las: grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad sel ba'i thabs ni: pad+ma drag po'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor mtshan ldan shel lta bu: mi gtsang rdzas kyis 'ja' tshon bsgribs pa bzhin: bla med gsang sngags sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: grib kyi dri mas ya mtshan rtogs tshogs sgrib: dri med mdangs kyis ya mtshan skyed pa'i thabs: ye shes zer gyis dri ma sreg par byed: gang de ye shes rab 'bar zer 'byung bas: ji bzhin sgrubs shig skal ldan rjes 'jug rnams: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bal dkar 'om bu shug pa'i shing byang la: snying po'i sngags sham btags pa'i bsreg rdzas bsags: mu khyud gnyis ldan 'dab bzhi'i lte ba na: 'byung ba'i sa bon bkod pa'i mu khyud phyir: sngon gyi bsreg shing dkar dmar bsnol mar brtsig: dkar nag til gyi rdzas la brten pa yi: dkyil 'khor dbus su me lha sku mdog dkar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis bgrang phreng spyi blugs 'dzin: zhabs gnyis ra skyes khri la phyed skyil bzhugs: thugs kar sme ba brtsegs ma sku mdog dkar: dag byed me long ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin: spyi bor ye shes rab 'bar gtso bos brgyan: ye shes 'gugs shing dam tshig rten la bstim: hūm̐ hrī: ye shes rab 'bar bka' yi mtshams 'dzin pa: ag+ni drang srong gtso bo gnas 'dir gshegs: 'bar ba'i dal dang gnyis su ma mchis par: rnal 'byor grib gdon bsal phyir brtan par bzhugs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hrī: ye shes rab 'bar drag po'i bka' byung gis: pho nya sme ba brtsegs ma 'dir gshegs shig: rnal 'byor grib gdon ma lus zhi ba dang: dag cing gtsang ma'i gzi mdangs bskyed du gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod: bsreg rdzas ni: til nag bsregs la: ā+om̐ ghar khaṃ tsir khaṃ bhi mā na se u tsus mo kro tī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: ā+om̐ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ye grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

zhes dang: ā+om̐ ghar khaṃ tsir khaṃ bhi mā na se u tsus mo kro dhī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: ā+om̐ sarba ar+tha sā dhā ya swā hā: grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes ci mang du brjod: hūm̐ hrī: ye shes rab 'bar dkyil 'khor du: phrin las lhun grub drang srong dang: gtsang dang zhi ldan sme ba brtsegs: lha mor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi dang gtsang ldan mdzad du gsol: yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang: bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes bde chen gnam chen brag dkar da la nas srung ma e ka tsā tis sprad pa ste/ skabs zhig 'grul 'tshub kyis grib 'jug pa dang*/ yid kyi grogs po pad+ma mkha' spyod kyis bskul ba'i dpal las rdzogs chen pa klong gsal snying pos dag par phab pa'o/// /
